Adult Preseptal and Orbital Cellulitis Treatment Guidelines The differentiation between preseptal and deep orbital cellulitis is difficult, based on clinical observation and clinical presentation may not always reflect the underlying disease severity. Subtle pathology may evolve into severe pathology very quickly. Joint ENT and Ophthalmology decision to proceed to CT scan, if impaired on eye examine or different or difficult to assess.
Examination and Recommendations Antibiotic Treatment

anaerobes 		Proptosis is absent,
The following are not impaired

  • Ocular Motility

8 hourly

for 7 days
